name: SUNeVision MEGA IDC, Tseung Kwan O
notes: SUNeVision says MEGA IDC Phase Two is underway; full three-phase development is described as 1.2 million sq ft GFA and over 180MW power capacity.

name: SUNeVision MEGA Gateway, Tsuen Wan
notes: DataCenterMap/Baxtel coverage reports SUNeVision opened MEGA Gateway in Tsuen Wan as a 20MW hyperscale facility in March 2023; secondary source used where official page did not expose a stable capacity line in search.

name: China Telecom Global TKO1, Tseung Kwan O
notes: Official CTG TKO1 page lists campus area 20,000 sq m, GFA 80,000 sq m, and total IT power capacity above 100MW, with Phase 1 above 10MW.

name: Vantage Tsuen Wan West HKG5
notes: Vantage project datasheet gives 48MW critical IT load and 700,000 sq ft for the Tsuen Wan West data center; later facility databases continue to list it as planned/developing.

name: Equinix HK6, Tsuen Wan
notes: Equinix announced a US$124m HK6 investment in 2024 and launched the AI-ready Tsuen Wan IBX in June 2026; first phase provides 1,000 cabinets and full build-out is 3,550 cabinets, but MW was not stated.

name: ESR Kwai Chung Data Centre HK1
notes: ESR secured a HK$1.6bn sustainability-linked loan to convert a Kwai Chung building into the 21.3MW ESR Kwai Chung Data Centre HK1; Baxtel indicates build/expansion activity through 2027.

name: Mapletree Fanling Data Centre
notes: Mapletree's development-capabilities page lists its first Hong Kong SAR data centre at Fanling with completion year 2026 and up to 50MVA building power; capacity_mw left null because source states MVA rather than MW.

name: GDS HK1, Kwai Chung
notes: GDS announced successful customer move-in at its first self-built Hong Kong data center; HK1 has 18.8MW total IT power and about 22,931 sq m floor area.

name: Goodman Tsuen Wan West Data Center Building 3 / GDS
notes: Goodman completed and handed over the third building at its Tsuen Wan West data center campus to GDS; DCD reports the facility as 50MW and part of a 225MW campus.

name: AirTrunk HKG1, Tsing Yi / Tsuen Wan area
notes: AirTrunk's official HKG1 page lists total capacity above 20MW, 17,400 sq m GFA, and over 8,000 sq m technical data hall area.

name: AirTrunk HKG2, East New Territories
notes: AirTrunk announced HKG2 as scalable to over 15MW with initial capacity due mid-2024; AirTrunk's current Hong Kong page says its Hong Kong data centres offer 35+MW, consistent with HKG1 plus HKG2 being in service.

name: Global Switch Hong Kong, Tseung Kwan O
notes: Global Switch's Hong Kong site is in Tseung Kwan O and supports AI/HPC workloads; announcement states 30MW of capacity available, while another official announcement cites 70,545 sq m and 100MVA utility power.

name: Sandy Ridge Data Centre and I&T Site
developer: Hong Kong Digital Policy Office / future private developers
notes: Government data-centre facilitation page states the 2024 Policy Address expanded the Sandy Ridge I&T site to 10 hectares for data centres and related purposes, with an RFI conducted March-April 2025.
